verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.randomlabs.ai (HTTP 200). It indexes the docs as markdown (.md) pages, so an agent can ingest them directly, and every docs page is served as a .md URL. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no first-party documentation describing or promoting the agent-oriented docs feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
